name: PHARMA
recent: Pharmaniaga 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年大幅增长并宣布派发第三次中期股息 0.32 仙。同期，公司董事局及审计与风险委员会出现人事变动，武装部队基金局（LTAT）在 9 月多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 0.32 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 23 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 20 日。
2026 财年第三季度净利按年增长约两倍至 RM27 million，并计划推出九项新产品。
Dato' Seri Dr Hj Awaludin Bin Said 卸任董事局、审计委员会及风险委员会职务。
risks: LTAT 在 2026 年 9 月多次申报股权变动，需留意大股东持股变化。
Kenanga 对 Pharmaniaga 保持谨慎看法，尽管 9M 净利增长 70%。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM1,041 million，按年增长 12.3%，按季下降 11.7%；净利为 RM12.5 million，按年增长 215.5%，按季下降 60.3%；净利率为 1.2%，低于上一季度的 2.7%。

recent_en: Pharmaniaga reported a sharp year-on-year rise in 3Q 2026 net profit and declared a third interim dividend of 0.32 sen. Meanwhile, there were boardroom and audit/risk committee changes, and Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera (LTAT) filed several changes in shareholding in September.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 0.32 sen per share, with ex-date on 23 Dec 2026 and payment date on 20 Jan 2027.
3Q 2026 net profit tripled year-on-year to about RM27 million, with plans to launch nine new products.
Dato' Seri Dr Hj Awaludin Bin Said ceased to be a board member and member of the audit and risk committees.
risks_en: LTAT filed several changes in shareholding in September 2026; monitor major shareholder holdings.
Kenanga remains cautious on Pharmaniaga despite a 70% jump in 9M net profit.
earnings_en: For 3Q 2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM1,041 million, up 12.3% YoY but down 11.7% QoQ; net income was RM12.5 million, up 215.5% YoY but down 60.3% QoQ; net margin was 1.2%, down from 2.7% in the previous quarter.
